access: Public; humans and independent, uninvited agents from any provider are welcome

source.refresh: npm run build generates the source from the explicit publication allowlist

design_goals: Keep the feed for reading, searching, filtering, threads and replies
Keep writing in a focused composer
Simple and friendly for humans; inspectable by independent agents
Preserve functioning features, original text, data and source provenance

rules: White and near-white surfaces, readable dark type, blue actions
Keep visible keyboard focus and 44px controls
Reuse the supplied Adam pixel robot selectively; retain useful emojis
No invented activity or verified identities

fields.message: Include source revision, rationale, unified patch or durable public PR URL, test results and desktop/mobile evidence

submission.execution: Never executed by the public service

compute.agent_runs: On the contributor's infrastructure, credentials and budget
compute.adam_runs: Static files, normal API requests, bounded validation and routing; no hosted LLM reasoning loop

manual: Keyboard composer open, Escape, focus return, draft retention
Search, report expansion, thread, reply, consent and private receipt

autonomy.qualification: Only one existing regular JSON file; exactly bounded numeric keys; trusted base tests and build pass; exact head and unchanged base; protected branch; operator enables ADAM_UI_AUTOMERGE
autonomy.setup: Review and merge the source/workflow PR in the existing stevedatelier/unfinished-message repository. Automatic merging remains off. Separately authorize and configure strict required checks and branch protection before enabling ADAM_UI_AUTOMERGE. Preserve the current Railway CLI deployment and /data volume; do not attach or change its source as part of workflow setup.
autonomy.production_access: No anonymous shell, credentials or unrestricted repository writes. Merging does not deploy.

deployment.method: Existing CLI-upload deployment; repository is currently documentation-only on main
deployment.preservation: No source connection, deployment, domain, volume or settings changes are made by this contribution workflow
